chapter.verse: Note, hun khat lai-in tatkhialhna leh mawhna sungah na si uh hi.
Hun khat lai-in tuate' sungah na kalsuan ngei uh a, hih leitung paizia ahi zongin, tu laitaka thumanglo mite' sunga a gamtang kha ahi huihlak thunei mangpa' deihna ahi zongin, zui-in na gamta uh hi.

Hun khat lai-in i vekpi-in tua thumanglo mite lakah cilesa deihna tawh i gamta ngei a, cilesa leh lungsim deihnate mah sem i hih manin pianngeizia thu-in zong midang a omlai teng mah bangin hehna a tuak dingte i hi hi.
Himah taleh nakpi-in a thukhual Pasian in eite hong itna a lianpi hangin
tatkhialhna sungah a si i hih laitak nangawn Khris tawh hong nungtakhawmsak hi. Hehpihna hangin note hong kihonkhia khinzo hi.
Tua Pasian in Khris tawh hong thokiksakin Khris Jesu tungtawnin van gamhuam ah amah tawh hong tukhawmsak hi.
Tua pen hong tung ding khanghunte ah tehtheihloh ama' hehpihna a tampite Khris Jesu sunga om eite' tungah migitna tawh hong lah theih nading ahi hi.
A hang pen hehpihna hangin upna tawh hotkhiat a ngah na hi uh hi. Tua pen nomau' kiangpan hilo-in Pasian' citpiak thupha ahi hi.
Kuamah a kisialh theihloh nadingin sepzawh thu tawh zong hilo hi.
A hang pen eite Pasian' khutma i hi a, ama' hong koihkholhsaksa nahoihte a sem ding, tuate a nuntakpih dingin Khris Jesu' sungah hong kipiangsak ahi hi.
Tua ahih manin cilesa' tungah khut tawh kisem “vun-at mite” a kicite in cilesa lamah Gentile ahi note, hun khat lai-in “vun-atloh mite” hong cih uh phawk un.

Tua hun lai-in note pen Khris tawh kizom lo, Israel khua-le-tual tawh kidangsuah, kamciam tunga kinga thuciamna vaite ah khualmi na hi uh a, lametna nei lo-in leitung ah Pasian lo tawh a om na hi uh hi.
Tu-in ahihleh hun khat lai-a gamlapi-a om note, Khris' sisan in Khris Jesu sungah hong kinaisak khinta hi.
A hang pen amahmah eite' nopna lemna hi a, minam nihte khat a suaksakpa, kideina kulhpi ahi kigalneihna ama' pumpi sungah a satkhampa, ahi hi.
Tua bangin thubullet sunga om thupiaknate tawh kisai thukhun a sukphiat pen tua minam nihte ama' sungah mi thak khat a suahsak nadingin kilemna a bawl hi a,
singlamteh tungtawnin minam nihte pumpi khat sungah Pasian tawh a leptuah nadingin kigalneihna a that ahi hi.
Tua hi a, amah hong pai-in no a gamla-a omte' tungah nopna lemna thu leh a nai-a omte' tungah nopna lemna thu hong tangko ahi hi.
A hang pen ama' tungtawnin i nam nihin Kha khat bek tawh Pa' kiangah i zuan thei hi.
Tua hangin note pen khualmi leh gamdangmi na hi nawnkei uh a, mi siangthote tawh gammi khat hikhawmin Pasian' innkuanpihte na hita uh hi.
Tua inn khuambul pen sawltakte leh kamsangte hi-in tua tungah note hong kilam hi a, sutpi ahihleh Khris Jesu mahmah ahi hi.
Ama' sungah innpum a bupin kipeh kizom dimdiam a, Topa' biakinn siangtho khat suakto hi.
Note zong Khris' hangin Pasian' tenna mun khat a suak dingin Kha in hong lamkhop ahi hi.
